label: PF Backlog 563
title: EPIC: Tech Debt & Repo Hygiene (generated artifacts, script drift, gate gaps)
body:
## Goal
One home for repo-hygiene / tech-debt work that is not a product feature: generated-artifact freshness,
script/driver drift, gate gaps, and cross-platform issues.

## Children (attached)
- BI-PF-1244: single_path_check.py ROOT-as-Path crash (fixed).
- BI-PF-1249: pre-commit regenerates derived docs when data/backlog changes (docs-fresh staleness).

## Related (cross-linked, not moved)
- BI-PF-1232 (CI4 regenerate committed derived artifacts) - under the CI-green epic BI-PF-1228.
- BI-PF-0258 (auto-refresh generated docs in CI/pre-commit) - completed; coverage gap found here.
